segments: Hey, did you know that your pastor lying
to you about Easter Sunday?
While many people think that they're
celebrating the resurrection of Jesus
Christ, that's just not the truth. Check
this out. This Easter originally is
known in ancient Assyria and Babylon as
Istar, goddess of fertility, war, love,
and sex. This is why rabbits are
associated with Easter for the extreme
fertility and high sex drive. She is a
counterpart to the Samrian Nana and to
the cognate goddess Estarte or Astraoth,
also known as the devil. God never
commands us to celebrate Easter, but he
do commands us to celebrate his true
high hols like Passover and the day of
atonement. So instead of celebrating
Easter, come visit our UC Austin and
learn about God's true high hol dayss.
